name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying art history in Brussels, she took a part-time job at a classic car restoration shop. It was here, amidst the fumes of paint and the meticulous work of bringing vintage vehicles back to life, that she discovered her true calling. Sophie quickly learned the intricacies of paint application, color matching, and surface preparation.

She joined FVee Brasil five years ago, initially drawn by their commitment to using sustainable painting practices. Sophie's demanding personality pushes her to achieve perfection in every project. She believes that the visual appeal of a car is just as crucial as its performance, and she takes immense pride in delivering flawless paint jobs that reflect her team's high standards. Her experience and calm under pressure are invaluable during race weekends, ensuring that damaged bodywork is repaired quickly and effectively.

physical.description: Sophie is of average height with a thoughtful expression often creasing her brow.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when not actively painting.
Organizes her paint supplies by color family in a meticulously curated system.
Refuses to use any paint thinner except a specific brand imported from France.
